ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels, with white dominating the lateral lobes and black concentrated at the central peduncle region and trailing edge margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the outer 2/3 of both lobes. A dark, roughly triangular low-intensity region extends from the peduncle base toward the median notch. Numerous small, high-contrast dark circular clusters are scattered across the white lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a central convergence angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Notable macro-notching and jagged pixel-boundary disruptions at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature characterized by a steep inward sweep from the lateral tips toward the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-shaped high-contrast clusters (dark centers with white halos or white centers with dark halos) distributed across both lobes, with a prominent cluster on the mid-right lobe and several scattered on the left.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions are visible within the dark central region and on the inner portion of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and extreme jaggedness at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, suggesting historical physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A single, highly defined white circular ring with a dark center is positioned almost exactly on the vertical midline, slightly above the peduncle insertion point.
